Select compounds with IC50 activities in nM against human high-affinity nerve growth factor receptor (CHEMBL2815). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by target CHEMBL2815, standard_type IC50, and standard_units nM. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
